We can rewrite $X$ as:
$X = \left(16 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{5}-4 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{239}\right) + 4 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{239} - 4 \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{240}$
$X = \pi + 4 \left( \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{239} - \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{240} \right)$
Using the arctangent subtraction formula $\tan^{-1}(a) - \tan^{-1}(b) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{a-b}{1+ab}\right)$:
$\frac{1}{239} - \frac{1}{240} = \frac{240-239}{239 \times 240} = \frac{1}{57360}$
$1 + \left(\frac{1}{239}\right)\left(\frac{1}{240}\right) = 1 + \frac{1}{57360} = \frac{57361}{57360}$
So, $\tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{239} - \tan ^{-1} \frac{1}{240} = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1/57360}{57361/57360}\right) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{57361}\right)$.
